FAQ: Massage + Red Light for Nerve Pain
Q: Can massage therapy really help nerve pain like sciatica or carpal tunnel?
Yes. Massage reduces muscle tension and inflammation, which are common causes of nerve compression.
Q: How often should I get red light therapy for nerve healing?
We recommend 2–3 sessions/week for 4–6 weeks. Consistency is key for deep cellular repair.
